papers.title_en: Optimal Query Complexity for Ground-State Preparation
papers.authors: Boyang Chen, Minbo Gao, Xinzhao Wang, Shuo Zhou
papers.evidence: 块编码与基态制备的最优查询复杂度
papers.tldr: 本文确定在已知谱隙内能量阈值时制备基态的最优量子查询复杂度。给定哈密顿量的α-block-encoding U_H和初态制备预言机U_I，作者用常精度量子谱滤波构造纯化器，并通过量子振幅放大依次组合：期望算法重复“制备+高精度滤波”至成功，最坏算法用递增精度滤波并限制总查询。期望U_H查询为O((α/Δ)(γ^{-1}+log(1/ε)))，最坏为O((α/(γΔ))log(1/ε))，且期望下界匹配。该工作刻画了基态制备查询复杂度的最优性，并给出U_I调用界的最优条件。
papers.abstract_en: We determine the optimal query complexity of ground-state preparation to trace-distance error $\varepsilon$ when an energy threshold in the spectral gap is known. Let $U_H$ be an $α$-block-encoding of a Hamiltonian with unique ground state $|ψ_0\rangle$, and suppose $|\langleψ_0|U_I|0\rangle|\geγ$ for a state-preparation oracle $U_I$. The threshold lies at least $Δ/2$ above the ground-state energy and at least $Δ/2$ below every excited-state energy. We give two algorithms that prepare a state within trace distance $\varepsilon$ of the ground state. One uses $O((α/Δ)(γ^{-1}+\log(1/\varepsilon)))$ calls to $U_H$ in expectation; the other uses $O((α/(γΔ))\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls to $U_H$ in the worst case. We prove a lower bound matching the expected query count; the corresponding worst-case lower bound follows from Somma and de Wolf [SdW26]. The respective bounds on calls to $U_I$ are $O(1/γ)$ in expectation and $O(γ^{-1}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ in the worst case. On $(N+1)$-dimensional systems, these $U_I$ bounds are also optimal when the expected or worst-case count of $U_H$ calls, respectively, is $o((α/Δ)\sqrt N)$. Both algorithms use a constant-accuracy spectral filter to construct a purifier, which we then sequentially compose during amplitude amplification to prepare a state with constant overlap with the ground state. The expected-query algorithm repeats the preparation followed by one high-accuracy spectral filter until success. The worst-case algorithm uses filters of increasing accuracy and limits the total number of queries.
